hillburrow/saveDrunkenMaster.title: From brawler to downer
hillburrow/saveDrunkenMaster.description: When you came into Hillburrow's clinic, the doctor immediately tasked you with fetching medical supplies needed to save a patient's life. She needs a doctor bag, and says you can find one at the nearby shop.
hillburrow/saveDrunkenMaster.desc-player-healed: However, it turns out that you're the best field medic around. You successfully saved the patient using nothing but your own skills. Wow.
hillburrow/saveDrunkenMaster.desc-doctor-healed: Doctor's bag aren't so easy to come by, but you complied, and provided one, in order to save that pony's life. Your generosity won't be forgotten.
hillburrow/saveDrunkenMaster.desc-failed: But you just couldn't bother to spend time on somepony dumb enough to end up this badly wounded. Natural selection prevailed once again.
hillburrow/saveDrunkenMaster.desc-saved: Maybe you could've a chat with that poney. Considering the alcohol stench, you can guess he's a regular at the bar.
